title: Extracellular DNA Extraction from Sediment Using NucleoSpin Plant II Midi Kit
author: Cecile Chardon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beenjbde

steps.title: Prepare and weigh sediment tubes
steps.instruction: Annotate each 15 mL tube with sample ID, weigh empty tubes on a 0.01 g‑precision scale and record the weights; thaw sediment completely, homogenize with a sterilized spatula; transfer ≈4 g sediment into the annotated tube using a spatula for compact sediment or a cut 1000 µL tip for watery sediment, noting the method and any observations; weigh the tube with sediment and record the weight; if excess sediment remains, transfer it to a larger annotated tube, cross‑mark the storage tube, and store at –40 °C or –80 °C, recording the storage location.

substeps.instruction: Annotate 15 mL tubes (one tube per sample).
Weigh empty tubes (0.01 g precision) and note weights.
Thaw sediment fully; homogenize with sterile spatula.
Transfer ~4 g sediment: use spatula for compact sediment, or a cut 1000 µL tip for sediment with lots of water; record method and comments.
Weigh tube containing sediment and note weight.
If needed, move remaining sediment to a larger annotated tube, cross‑mark it, and store at –40 °C or –80 °C; note storage details.

steps.title: Add saturated phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Add saturated phosphate buffer (0.12 M Na₂HPO₄, pH ≈ 8, stored ≤1 week at +4 °C) in a volume equal to the sediment weight (e.g., 3.95 g sediment → 3.95 mL buffer); close the cap and optionally seal with parafilm.

steps.title: Agitate sediment suspension
steps.instruction: Attach the tubes to a rotatory agitator, agitate at slow speed at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, 10 minutes; transfer the supernatant (avoid the pellet) to a NucleoSpin® Filter Midi; centrifuge the filter at 4 500 × g, room temperature, 10 minutes; collect the clear flowthrough (aim for 4.5–5 mL) and discard the filter. If liquid does not pass, repeat centrifugation; if a pellet is visible, transfer the supernatant to a new 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Add buffer SB and vortex
steps.instruction: Add buffer SB at 0.25 volume per volume of clear flowthrough (e.g., 1.25 mL for 5 mL); vortex for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Load sample onto column (first load)
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Plant II Midi column in a 15 mL collection tube; load 4 mL of the sample onto the column; centrifuge at 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube.

steps.title: Load remaining sample onto column
steps.instruction: Load the remaining sample onto the column; centrifuge at 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube.

steps.title: First wash with buffer SB
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL buffer SB to the column; centrifuge 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube.

steps.title: Second wash with buffer PW1
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL buffer PW1 to the column; centrifuge 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube. (Note: PW1 may slightly reduce final yield.)

steps.title: Third wash with buffer PW2 (3 mL)
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL buffer PW2 (ethanol added during first use) to the column; centrifuge 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube.

steps.title: Final wash and dry membrane
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL buffer PW2 to the column; centrifuge 4 500 × g, room temperature, 10 minutes to remove residual wash buffer and dry the silica membrane; discard flowthrough and keep the column in the same collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with buffer PE
steps.instruction: Place the column into a new 15 mL collection tube; add 100 µL buffer PE pre‑heated to 65 °C onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge 4 500 × g, room temperature, 2 minutes; repeat with another 100 µL pre‑heated buffer PE into the same tube; discard the column; transfer the total eluate to a 2 mL tube; store DNA at –20 °C (or –40 °C to –80 °C for long‑term storage).
